title: The Secret of Tremendous Corporation

expected_binary.basis: Pinned ScummVM 2026.3.0 SLUDGE detection table for The Secret of Tremendous Corporation v6

license_expectations: CC-BY-SA-4.0 game material as stated by the official project site, Steam release and linked source repository
LGPL licensing of OpenSLUDGE is separate from the game-data rights basis and is not used to broaden the CC-BY-SA grant
reason: The official itch.io release links this source repository and labels the current downloadable release Version 6. The repository exposes a steam tag corresponding to the public Steam-era release, so Abandonware audits that release tag rather than a later 2018 master head. This pass pins commit/tree identity, preserves COPYING/README evidence, fingerprints core project files, and establishes a defensible release-source record for the ScummVM v6 package without executing repository code.
